This has to be one of the most technical. elaborate, and expensive choreographed performances ever made. Whether you like pop or not, there's no contest that Lady Gaga is one of today's most skilled and talented singers. To move and sing for nearly 13 minutes straight with no genuine pause, water break, and multiple dance numbers while still maintaining perfect pitch is beyond me. Her falsetto just after 9:45 is absolutely perfect. People spent years building and mastering instruments to create that sound, and here is Lady Gaga, hugging one of her fans and whispering into the microphone.
